units.source_text: 陆军少尉莱蒙特·洛茨，是萨·阿里巴·洛茨的小儿子。

en.t: Second Lieutenant Lemont Lotz of the army was the youngest son of Sa Aliba Lotz.

units.source_text: 他一九一四年作为志愿兵入伍，随卡沙第二兵团出征，一九一五年九月十四日进攻夫乌茨高地时战死了。

en.t: He enlisted as a volunteer in 1914, went to the front with the Kasha Second Corps, and was killed in action on September 14, 1915, during the assault on the Fuwuci Heights.

units.source_text: 不久，他通过女巫师莱纳德夫人和艾·维·匹伊塔阿茨，将天国的情况写了一篇详细的通讯。

en.t: Before long, through the medium Mrs. Leonard and A. V. Piitaats, he wrote a detailed message describing conditions in heaven.

units.source_text: 他的父亲洛茨博士将天国的消息编纂成一本大部头的书。

en.t: His father, Dr. Lotz, compiled the messages from heaven into a large volume.
